claims: Rory McIlroy achieved back-to-back Masters victories in 2025 and 2026.
Rory McIlroy is the latest golfer to achieve back-to-back Masters victories.
Rory McIlroy joins an elite group of only four players in history to defend their Masters title.
Jack Nicklaus achieved back-to-back Masters victories in 1965 and 1966.
Nick Faldo achieved back-to-back Masters victories in 1989 and 1990.
Tiger Woods achieved back-to-back Masters victories in 2001 and 2002.
Jack Nicklaus was the first player to win back-to-back Masters titles.
Nick Faldo won his back-to-back Masters titles in consecutive playoffs.
Rory McIlroy joined the group following a final-round rally in 2026.
Tiger Woods is a 15-time major champion.
Jack Nicklaus holds a record six Masters titles
